effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDT to the vault, which supplies it to Morpho Blue.
The vault mints hUSDT shares to `receiver`, computed from `assets` at the current share price, rounded down.
Before this, the vault accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipient, which sets the share price.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the exact USDT amount, the share ticker hUSDT without an amount, and the share receiver.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many hUSDT shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Descriptor shows only 'Share ticker' = $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker. Case 0: signer receives 0.719303 hUSDT, not on screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share amount. Optionally relabel 'Share ticker' to 'Receive shares (hUSDT)'.

cases.notes: USDT out 0.719303 shown exactly. hUSDT in 0.719303 shown only as ticker; the amount is computed by the vault.

effects: The vault mints exactly `shares` hUSDT to `receiver`.
The signer sends USDT to the vault in an amount the vault computes from `shares` at the current share price, rounded up; no maximum is set in calldata.
Before this, the vault accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', 'Deposit asset: USDT' with no amount, the exact share amount, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDT leaves the signer; the vault computes it from the share price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Descriptor field 'Deposit asset' shows only $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker. Case 1: signer sends 0.000001 USDT, no amount on screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value bounds the USDT amount. Relabel the field 'Pay with (amount set by share price)' so the signer knows the cost is not fixed.

findings.title: mint labels a bare ticker 'Deposit asset', which reads like an amount field.
findings.evidence: Descriptor mint field: {"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}; case 1 renders 'Deposit asset: USDT'.

cases.notes: Signer's only effect is 0.000001 USDT out; screen names USDT but no amount. Shares go to 0xdead, which is shown correctly.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns hUSDT shares from `owner`, computed from `assets` at the current share price, rounded up.
When `owner` is not the signer, the vault spends `owner`'s hUSDT allowance to the signer.
The vault withdraws from Morpho and sends exactly `assets` USDT to `receiver`.
Before this, the vault accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', exact USDT amount, the receiver and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw does not show the hUSDT shares burned from the owner; the vault computes them from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 2: signer burns 20913.75 hUSDT; the screen names no shares at all.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share amount. Optionally add a constant field 'Burns shares: hUSDT' so the signer sees which asset leaves.

cases.notes: USDT in 21000 shown exactly to the signer. hUSDT out 20913.75 not on screen; reader understood the position shrinks but not the share amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` hUSDT from `owner`, spending `owner`'s allowance to the signer when they differ.
The vault sends USDT to `receiver` in an amount computed from `shares` at the current share price, rounded down; no minimum is set in calldata.
Before this, the vault accrues interest and mints fee shares to the fee recipient.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the exact hUSDT share amount, the receiver and the owner; the asset received is not named.

findings.title: redeem never names USDT as the asset the receiver gets, though the descriptor has the constant.
findings.evidence: Descriptor redeem fields: shares, receiver, owner only; mint uses $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker but redeem does not. Case 3: signer receives 0.72087 USDT; reader wrote 'Underlying asset (likely USDT)'.
findings.fix: Add {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} to the redeem format.

findings.title: redeem cannot show the USDT amount received; the vault computes it from the share price.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 3: 0.72087 USDT in, no amount on screen.

cases.notes: hUSDT out 0.719303 shown exactly. USDT in 0.72087 not shown; asset not named either.
